Ekavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cittasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – atthi gantho, atthi no gantho. ⤵ Tividhena saṅkhārakkhandho – atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho.
Ubhatovaḍḍhakaṃ.
Sattavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato; atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno. Evaṃ sattavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Aparopi sattavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto; atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo; atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno. Evaṃ sattavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Catuvīsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā…pe… manosamphassajā cetanā. Evaṃ catuvīsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Aparopi catuvīsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā…pe… manosamphassajā cetanā; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā, sotasamphassajā cetanā, ghānasamphassajā cetanā, jivhāsamphassajā cetanā, kāyasamphassajā cetanā, manosamphassajā cetanā. Evaṃ catuvīsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Tiṃsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno ; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā …pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā…pe… manosamphassajā cetanā. Evaṃ tiṃsatividhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Bahuvidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā, sotasamphassajā cetanā, ghānasamphassajā cetanā, jivhāsamphassajā cetanā, kāyasamphassajā cetanā, manosamphassajā cetanā. Evaṃ bahuvidhena saṅkhārakkhandho.

Aparopi bahuvidhena saṅkhārakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā saṅkhārakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto …pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; cakkhusamphassajā cetanā, sotasamphassajā cetanā, ghānasamphassajā cetanā, jivhāsamphassajā cetanā, kāyasamphassajā cetanā, manosamphassajā cetanā. Evaṃ bahuvidhena saṅkhārakkhandho.
Ayaṃ vuccati saṅkhārakkhandho.
5. The Aggregate of Consciousness

Therein, what is the aggregate of consciousness? As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness with a root cause, and consciousness without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, and neutral consciousness. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there is consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there is consciousness joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of consciousness as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a tenfold class.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness with a root cause, and consciousness without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness joined with pleasant feeling, consciousness joined with painful feeling, and consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. There is consciousness that is a result, consciousness that produces results, and consciousness that is neither. There is consciousness taken up at birth and able to be clung to, consciousness not taken up but able to be clung to, and consciousness neither taken up nor able to be clung to. There is consciousness that is defiled and open to defilement, consciousness undefiled yet open to defilement, and consciousness neither defiled nor open to defilement. There is consciousness with both thought and examination, consciousness without thought but with examination only, and consciousness with neither thought nor examination. There is consciousness accompanied by joy, consciousness accompanied by happiness, and consciousness accompanied by equanimity. There is consciousness to be abandoned by seeing, consciousness to be abandoned by meditative development, and consciousness to be abandoned by neither. There is consciousness whose root causes are to be abandoned by seeing, whose root causes are to be abandoned by development, and whose root causes are to be abandoned by neither. There is consciousness leading to further accumulation, consciousness leading to dismantling, and consciousness leading to neither. There is consciousness of trainees, consciousness of those beyond training, and consciousness of neither. There is limited consciousness, expanded consciousness, and measureless consciousness. There is consciousness with a limited object, consciousness with an expanded object, and consciousness with a measureless object. There is inferior consciousness, middling consciousness, and superior consciousness. There is consciousness fixed in wrongness, consciousness fixed in rightness, and consciousness not fixed. There is consciousness with the path as its object, consciousness with the path as its cause, and consciousness with the path as its dominant factor. There is consciousness that has arisen, consciousness that has not arisen, and consciousness bound to arise. There is past consciousness, future consciousness, and present consciousness. There is consciousness with a past object, consciousness with a future object, and consciousness with a present object. There is internal consciousness, external consciousness, and consciousness both internal and external. There is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, and consciousness with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with root causes, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness that is not itself a root cause but has one, and consciousness that is not a root cause and has none. There is worldly consciousness, and consciousness beyond the world. There is consciousness knowable by some kinds of consciousness, and consciousness not knowable by some. There is consciousness subject to the mental taints, and consciousness free of them. There is consciousness joined with the taints, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the taints yet still subject to them, and consciousness dissociated from the taints and free of them. There is consciousness that the fetters can bind, and consciousness they cannot. There is consciousness joined with the fetters, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the fetters yet still able to be bound, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be bound. ⤵ There is consciousness that the ties can tie, and consciousness they cannot. There is consciousness joined with the ties, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the ties yet still able to be tied, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be tied. There is consciousness that the floods can sweep away, and consciousness they cannot. There is consciousness joined with the floods, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the floods yet still able to be swept away, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be swept away. There is consciousness that the yokes can bind, and consciousness they cannot. There is consciousness joined with the yokes, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the yokes yet still able to be yoked, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be yoked. There is consciousness that the hindrances can obstruct, and consciousness they cannot. There is consciousness joined with the hindrances, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the hindrances yet still able to be obstructed, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be obstructed. ⤵ There is consciousness that can be wrongly grasped, and consciousness that cannot. There is consciousness joined with wrong grasping, and consciousness dissociated from it. There is consciousness dissociated from wrong grasping yet still able to be wrongly grasped, and consciousness dissociated from it and unable to be wrongly grasped. There is consciousness taken up at birth, and consciousness not taken up. There is consciousness that can be clung to, and consciousness that cannot. There is consciousness joined with clinging, and consciousness dissociated from it. There is consciousness dissociated from clinging yet still able to be clung to, and consciousness dissociated from it and unable to be clung to. There is consciousness open to defilement, and consciousness not open to it. There is defiled consciousness, and undefiled consciousness. There is consciousness joined with the defilements, and consciousness dissociated from them. There is consciousness dissociated from the defilements yet still open to defilement, and consciousness dissociated from them and not open to defilement. There is consciousness to be abandoned by seeing, and consciousness not to be abandoned by seeing. There is consciousness to be abandoned by meditative development, and consciousness not to be abandoned by development. There is consciousness whose root causes are to be abandoned by seeing, and consciousness whose root causes are not. There is consciousness whose root causes are to be abandoned by development, and consciousness whose root causes are not. ⤵ There is consciousness with thought, and consciousness without thought. There is consciousness with examination, and consciousness without examination. There is consciousness with joy, and consciousness without joy. There is consciousness accompanied by joy, and consciousness not accompanied by joy. There is consciousness accompanied by happiness, and consciousness not accompanied by happiness. There is consciousness accompanied by equanimity, and consciousness not accompanied by equanimity. There is consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, and consciousness not belonging to it. There is consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, and consciousness not belonging to it. There is consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not belonging to it. There is consciousness included in the round of existence, and consciousness outside it. There is consciousness that leads out of the round, and consciousness that does not. There is consciousness fixed in its outcome, and consciousness not fixed. There is consciousness that can be surpassed, and consciousness that cannot. There is consciousness involving conflict, and consciousness free from conflict. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, and neutral consciousness… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.
5. Viññāṇakkhandho

Tattha katamo viññāṇakkhandho? Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sahetuko, atthi ahetuko. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato. ⤵ Catubbidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno. ⤵ Pañcavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sukhindriyasampayutto, atthi dukkhindriyasampayutto, atthi somanassindriyasampayutto, atthi domanassindriyasampayutto, atthi upekkhindriyasampayutto. Evaṃ pañcavidhena viññāṇakkhandho. ⤵ Chabbidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ. Evaṃ chabbidhena viññāṇakkhandho. ⤵ Sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu. Evaṃ sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho. ⤵ Aṭṭhavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ atthi sukhasahagataṃ, atthi dukkhasahagataṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu . Evaṃ aṭṭhavidhena viññāṇakkhandho. ⤵ Navavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu atthi kusalaṃ, atthi akusalaṃ, atthi abyākataṃ. Evaṃ navavidhena viññāṇakkhandho. ⤵ Dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ atthi sukhasahagataṃ, atthi dukkhasahagataṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu atthi kusalaṃ, atthi akusalaṃ, atthi abyākataṃ. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sahetuko, atthi ahetuko. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto. Atthi vipāko, atthi vipākadhammadhammo, atthi nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo. Atthi upādinnupādāniyo, atthi anupādinnupādāniyo, atthi anupādinnaanupādāniyo. Atthi saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko, atthi asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko, atthi asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko. Atthi savitakkasavicāro, atthi avitakkavicāramatto , atthi avitakkaavicāro. Atthi pītisahagato, atthi sukhasahagato, atthi upekkhāsahagato. Atthi dassanena pahātabbo, atthi bhāvanāya pahātabbo, atthi neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo. Atthi dassanena pahātabbahetuko, atthi bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko, atthi neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko. Atthi ācayagāmī, atthi apacayagāmī, atthi nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī. Atthi sekkho, atthi asekkho, atthi nevasekkhanāsekkho. Atthi paritto, atthi mahaggato, atthi appamāṇo. Atthi parittārammaṇo, atthi mahaggatārammaṇo, atthi appamāṇārammaṇo. Atthi hīno, atthi majjhimo, atthi paṇīto. Atthi micchattaniyato, atthi sammattaniyato, atthi aniyato. Atthi maggārammaṇo, atthi maggahetuko, atthi maggādhipati. Atthi ajjhatto, atthi bahiddho, atthi ajjhattabahiddho. Atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi hetusampayutto, atthi hetuvippayutto. Atthi na hetu sahetuko, atthi na hetu ahetuko. Atthi lokiyo, atthi lokuttaro. Atthi ganthavippayuttaganthaniyo, atthi ganthavippayuttaaganthaniyo. Atthi oghaniyo, atthi anoghaniyo. Atthi oghasampayutto, atthi oghavippayutto. Atthi oghavippayuttaoghaniyo, atthi oghavippayuttaanoghaniyo. Atthi yoganiyo, atthi ayoganiyo. Atthi yogasampayutto, atthi yogavippayutto . Atthi yogavippayuttayoganiyo, atthi yogavippayuttaayoganiyo. Atthi nīvaraṇiyo, atthi anīvaraṇiyo. Atthi nīvaraṇasampayutto, atthi nīvaraṇavippayutto. Atthi nīvaraṇavippayuttanīvaraṇiyo, atthi nīvaraṇavippayuttaanīvaraṇiyo. ⤵ Atthi parāmaṭṭho, atthi aparāmaṭṭho. Atthi parāmāsasampayutto, atthi parāmāsavippayutto. Atthi parāmāsavippayuttaparāmaṭṭho, atthi parāmāsavippayuttaaparāmaṭṭho. Atthi upādinno, atthi anupādinno. Atthi upādāniyo, atthi anupādāniyo. Atthi upādānasampayutto, atthi upādānavippayutto. Atthi upādānavippayuttaupādāniyo, atthi upādānavippayuttaanupādāniyo. Atthi saṃkilesiko, atthi asaṃkilesiko. Atthi saṃkiliṭṭho, atthi asaṃkiliṭṭho. Atthi kilesasampayutto, atthi kilesavippayutto. Atthi kilesavippayuttasaṃkilesiko, atthi kilesavippayuttaasaṃkilesiko. Atthi dassanena pahātabbo, atthi na dassanena pahātabbo. Atthi bhāvanāya pahātabbo , atthi na bhāvanāya pahātabbo. Atthi dassanena pahātabbahetuko, atthi na dassanena pahātabbahetuko. Atthi bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko, atthi na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko. ⤵ Atthi savitakko, atthi avitakko. Atthi savicāro, atthi avicāro. Atthi sappītiko, atthi appītiko. Atthi pītisahagato, atthi na pītisahagato. Atthi sukhasahagato, atthi na sukhasahagato. Atthi upekkhāsahagato, atthi na upekkhāsahagato. Atthi kāmāvacaro , atthi na kāmāvacaro. Atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi na rūpāvacaro. Atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi na arūpāvacaro, atthi pariyāpanno, atthi apariyāpanno. Atthi niyyāniko, atthi aniyyāniko. Atthi niyato, atthi aniyato. Atthi sauttaro, atthi anuttaro. Atthi saraṇo, atthi araṇo. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness subject to the mental taints, and consciousness free of them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with both thought and examination, consciousness without thought but with examination only, and consciousness with neither thought nor examination… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

Tikamūlakaṃ.

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sāsavo, atthi anāsavo. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi savitakkasavicāro, atthi avitakkavicāramatto, atthi avitakkaavicāro…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with the taints, and consciousness dissociated from them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness accompanied by joy, consciousness accompanied by happiness, and consciousness accompanied by equanimity… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness dissociated from the taints yet still subject to them, and consciousness dissociated from the taints and free of them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness to be abandoned by seeing, consciousness to be abandoned by meditative development, and consciousness to be abandoned by neither… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the fetters can bind, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness whose root causes are to be abandoned by seeing, whose root causes are to be abandoned by development, and whose root causes are to be abandoned by neither… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with the fetters, and consciousness dissociated from them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness leading to further accumulation, consciousness leading to dismantling, and consciousness leading to neither… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness dissociated from the fetters yet still able to be bound, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be bound. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness of trainees, consciousness of those beyond training, and consciousness of neither… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the ties can tie, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is limited consciousness, expanded consciousness, and measureless consciousness… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with the ties, and consciousness dissociated from them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with a limited object, consciousness with an expanded object, and consciousness with a measureless object… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness dissociated from the ties yet still able to be tied, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be tied. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is inferior consciousness, middling consciousness, and superior consciousness… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the floods can sweep away, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness fixed in wrongness, consciousness fixed in rightness, and consciousness not fixed… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with the floods, and consciousness dissociated from them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with the path as its object, consciousness with the path as its cause, and consciousness with the path as its dominant factor… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness dissociated from the floods yet still able to be swept away, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be swept away. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness that has arisen, consciousness that has not arisen, and consciousness bound to arise… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the yokes can bind, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is past consciousness, future consciousness, and present consciousness… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness joined with the yokes, and consciousness dissociated from them. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with a past object, consciousness with a future object, and consciousness with a present object… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness dissociated from the yokes yet still able to be yoked, and consciousness dissociated from them and unable to be yoked. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is internal consciousness, external consciousness, and consciousness both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.

As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the hindrances can obstruct, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, and consciousness with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.
The set expanding from both sides.

As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: there is wholesome consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, neutral consciousness, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class.

As another sevenfold class: there is consciousness joined with pleasant feeling, consciousness joined with painful feeling, consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere… there is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, consciousness with an object both internal and external, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class.

As a twenty-fourfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.

As another twenty-fourfold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness and mind-consciousness; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.

As a thirtyfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a thirtyfold class.

As a manifold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere – eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere – eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a manifold class.

As another manifold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a manifold class.
This is called the aggregate of consciousness.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi āsavasampayutto, atthi āsavavippayutto. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi pītisahagato, atthi sukhasahagato, atthi upekkhāsahagato…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi oghaniyo, atthi anoghaniyo. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi micchattaniyato, atthi sammattaniyato, atthi aniyato…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho .

Ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – phassasampayutto. ⤵ Duvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi yogasampayutto, atthi yogavippayutto. ⤵ Tividhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi atītārammaṇo, atthi anāgatārammaṇo, atthi paccuppannārammaṇo…pe…. Evaṃ dasavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Ubhatovaḍḍhakaṃ.
Sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno. Evaṃ sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Aparopi sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho – atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno. Evaṃ sattavidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Bahuvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā viññāṇakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… manoviññāṇaṃ; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā …pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā viññāṇakkhandho atthi kusalo, atthi akusalo, atthi abyākato, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… manoviññāṇaṃ. Evaṃ bahuvidhena viññāṇakkhandho.

Aparopi bahuvidhena viññāṇakkhandho – cakkhusamphassapaccayā viññāṇakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; sotasamphassapaccayā…pe… ghānasamphassapaccayā…pe… jivhāsamphassapaccayā…pe… kāyasamphassapaccayā…pe… manosamphassapaccayā viññāṇakkhandho atthi sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto…pe… atthi ajjhattārammaṇo, atthi bahiddhārammaṇo, atthi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇo, atthi kāmāvacaro, atthi rūpāvacaro, atthi arūpāvacaro, atthi apariyāpanno; cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ. Evaṃ bahuvidhena viññāṇakkhandho.
Ayaṃ vuccati viññāṇakkhandho.
Abhidhammabhājanīyaṃ.
3. The Section of Questions and Answers
There are five aggregates – the aggregate of material form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness.
Of the five aggregates, how many are wholesome, how many unwholesome, how many neutral… how many involve conflict, how many are free from conflict?
1. The Triads

The aggregate of material form is neutral. The other four aggregates may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. Two aggregates cannot be described as joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. Three aggregates may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The aggregate of material form is neither a result nor something that produces results. The other four aggregates may be results, may produce results, or may be neither. The aggregate of material form may be taken up at birth and able to be clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. The other four aggregates may be taken up and able to be clung to, not taken up but able to be clung to, or neither taken up nor able to be clung to. ⤵ The aggregate of material form is undefiled yet open to defilement. The other four aggregates may be defiled and open to defilement, undefiled yet open to defilement, or neither defiled nor open to defilement. The aggregate of material form is without thought and examination. Three aggregates may have both thought and examination, may have examination only, or may have neither. The aggregate of mental formations may have both thought and examination, may have examination only, may have neither, or may not be describable as any of these. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as accompanied by joy, accompanied by happiness, or accompanied by equanimity. The aggregate of feeling may be accompanied by joy but is not accompanied by happiness or equanimity, or it may not be describable as accompanied by joy. Three aggregates may be accompanied by joy, by happiness, or by equanimity, or may not be describable as accompanied by any of these. ⤵ The aggregate of material form is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by meditative development. The other four aggregates may be abandoned by seeing, may be abandoned by development, or may be abandoned by neither. The aggregate of material form has root causes to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. The other four aggregates may have root causes to be abandoned by seeing, root causes to be abandoned by development, or root causes to be abandoned by neither. The aggregate of material form neither leads to further accumulation nor to dismantling. The other four aggregates may lead to accumulation, may lead to dismantling, or may lead to neither. The aggregate of material form belongs neither to trainees nor to those beyond training. The other four aggregates may belong to trainees, to those beyond training, or to neither. The aggregate of material form is limited. The other four aggregates may be limited, expanded, or measureless. The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates may have a limited object, an expanded object, or a measureless object, or may not be describable as having any of these. The aggregate of material form is middling. The other four aggregates may be inferior, middling, or superior. The aggregate of material form is not fixed in its outcome. The other four aggregates may be fixed in wrongness, fixed in rightness, or not fixed. ⤵ The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates may have the path as their object, the path as their cause, or the path as their dominant factor, or may not be describable as any of these; they may have arisen, may not have arisen, or may be bound to arise; they may be past, future, or present. The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates may have a past object, a future object, or a present object, or may not be describable as having any of these; they may be internal, external, or both internal and external. The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, or may not be describable as having any of these. Four aggregates are invisible and offer no resistance. The aggregate of material form may be visible and offer resistance, may be invisible and offer resistance, or may be invisible and offer no resistance.
3. Pañhāpucchakaṃ
Pañcakkhandhā – rūpakkhandho, vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho.
Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā…pe… kati saraṇā, kati araṇā?
1. Tikaṃ

Rūpakkhandho abyākato. Cattāro khandhā siyā kusalā, siyā akusalā, siyā abyākatā. Dve khandhā na vattabbā – "sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā"tipi, "dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā"tipi, "adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā"tipi. Tayo khandhā siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, siyā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā. Rūpakkhandho nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo. Cattāro khandhā siyā vipākā, siyā vipākadhammadhammā, siyā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā. Rūpakkhandho siyā upādinnupādāniyo, siyā anupādinnupādāniyo . Cattāro khandhā siyā upādinnupādāniyā, siyā anupādinnupādāniyā, siyā anupādinnaanupādāniyā. ⤵ Rūpakkhandho asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko. Cattāro khandhā siyā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā, siyā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā, siyā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā. Rūpakkhandho avitakkaavicāro. Tayo khandhā siyā savitakkasavicārā, siyā avitakkavicāramattā, siyā avitakkaavicārā. Saṅkhārakkhandho siyā savitakkasavicāro, siyā avitakkavicāramatto, siyā avitakkaavicāro, siyā na vattabbo – "savitakkasavicāro"tipi, "avitakkavicāramatto"tipi, "avitakkaavicāro"tipi. Rūpakkhandho na vattabbo – "pītisahagato"tipi, "sukhasahagato"tipi, "upekkhāsahagato"tipi. Vedanākkhandho siyā pītisahagato na sukhasahagato na upekkhāsahagato, siyā na vattabbo – "pītisahagato"ti. Tayo khandhā siyā pītisahagatā, siyā sukhasahagatā, siyā upekkhāsahagatā, siyā na vattabbā – "pītisahagatā"tipi, "sukhasahagatā"tipi, "upekkhāsahagatā"tipi. ⤵ Rūpakkhandho neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo. Cattāro khandhā siyā dassanena pahātabbā, siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā, siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā. Rūpakkhandho neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko. Cattāro khandhā siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā, siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā, siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā. Rūpakkhandho nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī. Cattāro khandhā siyā ācayagāmino, siyā apacayagāmino, siyā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmino. Rūpakkhandho nevasekkhanāsekkho. Cattāro khandhā siyā sekkhā, siyā asekkhā, siyā nevasekkhanāsekkhā. Rūpakkhandho paritto. Cattāro khandhā siyā parittā, siyā mahaggatā, siyā appamāṇā. Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā siyā parittārammaṇā, siyā mahaggatārammaṇā, siyā appamāṇārammaṇā, siyā na vattabbā – "parittārammaṇā"tipi , "mahaggatārammaṇā"tipi, "appamāṇārammaṇā"tipi. Rūpakkhandho majjhimo. Cattāro khandhā siyā hīnā, siyā majjhimā, siyā paṇītā. Rūpakkhandho aniyato . Cattāro khandhā siyā micchattaniyatā, siyā sammattaniyatā, siyā aniyatā. ⤵ Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā siyā maggārammaṇā, siyā maggahetukā, siyā maggādhipatino, siyā na vattabbā – "maggārammaṇā"tipi, "maggahetukā"tipi , "maggādhipatino"tipi; siyā uppannā, siyā anuppannā, siyā uppādino; siyā atītā, siyā anāgatā, siyā paccuppannā. Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā siyā atītārammaṇā, siyā anāgatārammaṇā, siyā paccuppannārammaṇā, siyā na vattabbā – "atītārammaṇā"tipi, "anāgatārammaṇā"tipi, "paccuppannārammaṇā"tipi; siyā ajjhattā, siyā bahiddhā, siyā ajjhattabahiddhā. Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā siyā ajjhattārammaṇā, siyā bahiddhārammaṇā, siyā ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇā, siyā na vattabbā – "ajjhattārammaṇā"tipi, "bahiddhārammaṇā"tipi, "ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇā"tipi. Cattāro khandhā anidassanaappaṭighā. Rūpakkhandho siyā sanidassanasappaṭigho, siyā anidassanasappaṭigho, siyā anidassanaappaṭigho.
2. Dukaṃ
2. The Pairs

Four aggregates are not root causes. The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause or not. The aggregate of material form is without root causes. Four aggregates are not mental taints. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint or not. The aggregate of material form is subject to the taints. Four aggregates are not fetters. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter or not. The aggregate of material form can be bound by the fetters. Four aggregates are not floods… not yokes… not hindrances. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance or not. The aggregate of material form can be obstructed by the hindrances. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging joined with clinging, may be joined with clinging without being clinging, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from clinging yet able to be clung to. Four aggregates are not defilements. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement or not. The aggregate of material form is open to defilement. The Section of Questions and Answers is finished.
