7. The Tetrad of Association

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation associated with ignorance; with the formation as condition, consciousness associated with the formation; with consciousness as condition, mentality associated with consciousness; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field associated with mentality; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact associated with the sixth sense-field; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact; with feeling as condition, craving associated with feeling; with craving as condition, clinging associated with craving; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition, associated with contact? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition, associated with contact". ⤵ Therein, what is the craving that has feeling as condition, associated with feeling? The lust, passion… passion of the mind — this is called "the craving that has feeling as condition, associated with feeling". ⤵ Therein, what is the clinging that has craving as condition, associated with craving? The view, resort to views… the sectarian domain, the distorted grip — this is called "the clinging that has craving as condition, associated with craving"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation associated with ignorance; with the formation as condition, consciousness associated with the formation; with consciousness as condition, mentality associated with consciousness; with mentality as condition, contact associated with mentality; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact; with feeling as condition, craving associated with feeling; with craving as condition, clinging associated with craving; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness". ⤵ "With mentality as condition, contact associated with mentality": therein, what is mentality? Setting aside contact: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "mentality". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation associated with ignorance; with the formation as condition, consciousness associated with the formation; with consciousness as condition, mentality and material form, the mentality being associated with consciousness; with mentality and material form as condition, the sixth sense-field associated with mentality; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact associated with the sixth sense-field; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact; with feeling as condition, craving associated with feeling; with craving as condition, clinging associated with craving; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation". ⤵ Therein, what are the mentality and material form that have consciousness as condition, the mentality being associated with consciousness? There is mentality, there is material form. Therein, what is mentality? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "mentality". Therein, what is material form? The growth of the eye sense-field, the growth of the ear sense-field, the growth of the nose sense-field, the growth of the tongue sense-field, the growth of the body sense-field, or whatever other material form there is that is born of mind, caused by mind, originated by mind — this is called "material form". So this is mentality and this is material form. This is called "the mentality and material form that have consciousness as condition, the mentality being associated with consciousness". ⤵ "With mentality and material form as condition, the sixth sense-field associated with mentality": there is mentality, there is material form. Therein, what is mentality? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "mentality". Therein, what is material form? The material form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs — this is called "material form". So this is mentality and this is material form. This is called "mentality and material form". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality and material form as condition, associated with mentality? So this is mentality and this is material form. This is called "the mentality and material form that have consciousness as condition, the mentality being associated with consciousness". ⤵ "With mentality and material form as condition, the six sense-fields, the sixth sense-field being associated with mentality": there is mentality, there is material form. Therein, what is mentality? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "mentality". Therein, what is material form? The four great elements and the material form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs — this is called "material form". So this is mentality and this is material form. This is called "mentality and material form". ⤵ Therein, what are the six sense-fields that have mentality and material form as condition, the sixth sense-field being associated with mentality? The eye sense-field, the ear sense-field, the nose sense-field, the tongue sense-field, the body sense-field, the mind sense-field — this is called "the six sense-fields that have mentality and material form as condition, the sixth sense-field being associated with mentality". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "nāmapaccayā phasso nāmasampayutto"…pe… tena vuccati "evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī"ti.

8. The Tetrad of Mutuality

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation, and with the formation as condition, ignorance too; with the formation as condition, consciousness, and with consciousness as condition, the formation too; with consciousness as condition, mentality, and with mentality as condition, consciousness too; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field, and with the sixth sense-field as condition, mentality too; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact, and with contact as condition, the sixth sense-field too; with contact as condition, feeling, and with feeling as condition, contact too; with feeling as condition, craving, and with craving as condition, feeling too; with craving as condition, clinging, and with clinging as condition, craving too; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the ignorance that has the formation as condition too? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "the ignorance that has the formation as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called the consciousness that has the formation as condition. ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has consciousness as condition too? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has consciousness as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has mentality as condition too? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has mentality as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has the sixth sense-field as condition too? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has the sixth sense-field as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has contact as condition too? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has contact as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has feeling as condition too? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has feeling as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the craving that has feeling as condition? The lust, passion… passion of the mind — this is called "the craving that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has craving as condition too? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has craving as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the clinging that has craving as condition? The view, resort to views… the sectarian domain, the distorted grip — this is called "the clinging that has craving as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the craving that has clinging as condition too? The lust… passion of the mind — this is called "the craving that has clinging as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has clinging as condition? Setting aside clinging: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has clinging as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the birth that has existence as condition? The birth of the various states, their being born, arising, coming forth, appearance — this is called "the birth that has existence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what are the aging and death that have birth as condition? There is aging, there is death. Therein, what is aging? The aging of the various states, their growing old, the decline of their life span — this is called "aging". Therein, what is death? The destruction of the various states, their vanishing, breakup, disintegration, impermanence, disappearance — this is called "death". So this is aging and this is death. This is called "the aging and death that have birth as condition". ⤵ "Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering": thus there is the coming together of this entire mass of suffering, its meeting, its combination, its appearance. Therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation, and with the formation as condition, ignorance too; with the formation as condition, consciousness, and with consciousness as condition, the formation too; with consciousness as condition, mentality, and with mentality as condition, consciousness too; with mentality as condition, contact, and with contact as condition, mentality too; with contact as condition, feeling, and with feeling as condition, contact too; with feeling as condition, craving, and with craving as condition, feeling too; with craving as condition, clinging, and with clinging as condition, craving too; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the ignorance that has the formation as condition too? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "the ignorance that has the formation as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has consciousness as condition too? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has consciousness as condition too". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has mentality as condition too? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has mentality as condition too". ⤵ "With mentality as condition, contact": therein, what is mentality? Setting aside contact: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "mentality". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has mentality as condition? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has mentality as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has contact as condition too? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the mentality that has contact as condition too"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".
8. Aññamaññacatukkaṃ

Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro; viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ; nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ; chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ; phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayāpi phasso; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "avijjā". ⤵ Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro". ⤵ Tattha katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ. ⤵ Tattha katamo viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati "viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho , saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati "chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati "phassapaccayā vedanā". ⤵ Tattha katamo vedanāpaccayāpi phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "vedanāpaccayāpi phasso". ⤵ Tattha katamā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā? Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… cittassa sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati "vedanāpaccayā taṇhā". ⤵ Tattha katamā taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati "taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ? Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho – idaṃ vuccati "taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamā upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jāti sañjāti nibbatti abhinibbati pātubhāvo – ayaṃ vuccati "bhavapaccayā jāti". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ? Atthi jarā, atthi maraṇaṃ. Tattha katamā jarā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jarā jīraṇatā āyuno saṃhāni – ayaṃ vuccati "jarā". Tattha katamaṃ maraṇaṃ? Yo tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati "maraṇaṃ". Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro". ⤵ Tattha katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? 9. The Exposition of the Unwholesome

Which things are unwholesome? On the occasion when an unwholesome mind has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with a view, with prompting… accompanied by joy, dissociated from a view, with a sight as its object… accompanied by joy, dissociated from a view, with prompting, with a sight as its object, or a sound as its object, or a smell as its object, or a taste as its object, or a tangible thing as its object, or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, craving; with craving as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has craving as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are unwholesome? On the occasion when an unwholesome mind has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, associated with a view, with a sight as its object, or a sound as its object, or a smell as its object, or a taste as its object, or a tangible thing as its object, or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, craving; with craving as condition, clinging; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

10. The Exposition of the Wholesome

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when a wholesome mind of the sense sphere has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with a sight as its object, or a sound as its object, or a smell as its object, or a taste as its object, or a tangible thing as its object, or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "avijjā". ⤵ Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? 10. Kusalaniddeso

Katame dhammā kusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇasampayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye kusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā pasādo, pasādapaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Therein, what are the wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hate, non-delusion. ⤵ Therein, what is non-greed? The non-greed, absence of greed, state of being without greed, non-passion, absence of passion, state of being without passion, non-covetousness, the non-greed that is a wholesome root — this is called "non-greed". ⤵ Therein, what is non-hate? The non-hate, absence of hating, state of being without hate, non-ill-will, freedom from ill-will, the non-hate that is a wholesome root — this is called "non-hate". ⤵ Therein, what is non-delusion? The wisdom, understanding… non-delusion, investigation of things, right view — this is called "non-delusion". These are called "the wholesome roots". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition… the mentality that has consciousness as condition… the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition… the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition… the feeling that has contact as condition… this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the confidence that has feeling as condition? The confidence, trusting, reliance, full confidence — this is called "the confidence that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the decision that has confidence as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has confidence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

On the occasion when a wholesome mind of the sense sphere has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with a sight as its object… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting, with a sight as its object, or a sound as its object, or a smell as its object, or a taste as its object, or a tangible thing as its object, or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what are the wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hate — these are called "the wholesome roots". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the fine-material sphere — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what are the wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hate, non-delusion — these are called "the wholesome roots". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the immaterial sphere — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what are the wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hate, non-delusion — these are called "the wholesome roots". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition"… this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when one develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of views, for reaching the first stage — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of these things.

Therein, what are the wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hate, non-delusion. ⤵ Therein, what is non-greed… non-hate… non-delusion? The wisdom, understanding… non-delusion, investigation of things, right view, the awakening factor of investigation of things, a path factor, included in the path — this is called "non-delusion". These are called "the wholesome roots". ⤵ Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition"… this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the confidence that has feeling as condition? The confidence, trusting, reliance, full confidence — this is called "the confidence that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the decision that has confidence as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has confidence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition"… this is called "the aging and death that have birth as condition". ⤵ "Thus there is the origin of these things": thus there is the coming together of these things, their meeting, their combination, their appearance. Therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of these things".
The Exposition of the Wholesome.

Tattha katame kusalamūlā? Alobho, adoso, amoho. ⤵ Tattha katamo alobho? Yo alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "alobho". ⤵ Tattha katamo adoso? Yo adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "adoso". ⤵ Tattha katamo amoho? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati "amoho". Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇasampayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena rūpārammaṇaṃ vā…pe… somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇavippayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā…pe… somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇavippayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye kusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ , viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā pasādo, pasādapaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. 11. The Exposition of the Neutral

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant eye-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding eye-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding eye-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental experience that is neither comfortable nor uncomfortable, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant experience born of mind-contact, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has feeling as condition? Setting aside feeling: the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has feeling as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

On that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness with the formation as its cause; with consciousness as condition, mentality with consciousness as its cause; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field with mentality as its cause; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact with the sixth sense-field as its cause; with contact as condition, feeling with contact as its cause; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

On that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness associated with the formation; with consciousness as condition, mentality associated with consciousness; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field associated with mentality; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact associated with the sixth sense-field; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

On that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness, and with consciousness as condition, the formation too; with consciousness as condition, mentality, and with mentality as condition, consciousness too; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field, and with the sixth sense-field as condition, mentality too; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact, and with contact as condition, the sixth sense-field too; with contact as condition, feeling, and with feeling as condition, contact too; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition"… this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? 11. Abyākataniddeso

Katame dhammā abyākatā? Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacarassa kusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Tattha katamo saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "saṅkhāro". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjācakkhuviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho , saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati "viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjācakkhuviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso". ⤵ Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā adukkhamasukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati "phassapaccayā vedanā". ⤵ Tattha katamo vedanāpaccayā bhavo? Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object, or a sound as its object, or a smell as its object, or a taste as its object, or a tangible thing as its object, or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge… accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the fine-material sphere — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same fine-material-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, as its result — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when the mind element has arisen — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action — accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a tangible thing as its object… or the mind-consciousness element has arisen — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action — accompanied by joy, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object… or the mind-consciousness element has arisen — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action — accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when the mind-consciousness element has arisen — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action — accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge… accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops a fine-material-sphere meditative absorption — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action, a pleasant dwelling in this very life — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops an immaterial-sphere meditative absorption — functional, neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of action, a pleasant dwelling in this very life — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion, with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

12. The Exposition of the Wholesome Rooted in Ignorance

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when a wholesome mind of the sense sphere has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition"… this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the confidence that has feeling as condition? The confidence, trusting, reliance, full confidence — this is called "the confidence that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the decision that has confidence as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has confidence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are wholesome? On the occasion when one develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of views, for reaching the first stage — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge — on that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of these things.
The Exposition of the Wholesome Rooted in Ignorance.
13. The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Wholesome

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant eye-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has a wholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has a wholesome root as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant ear-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sound as its object… nose-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a smell as its object… tongue-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a taste as its object… body-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by happiness, with a tangible thing as its object… the mind element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a tangible thing as its object… the mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by joy, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object… the mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge… accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the fine-material sphere — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same fine-material-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, as its result — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the immaterial sphere — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same immaterial-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, as its result — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of views, for reaching the first stage — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same wholesome meditative absorption beyond the world has been done and developed, as its result — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge, on emptiness — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. 14. The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Unwholesome

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant eye-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant ear-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sound as its object… nose-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a smell as its object… tongue-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a taste as its object… body-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by pain, with a tangible thing as its object… the mind element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a tangible thing as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental experience that is neither comfortable nor uncomfortable, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant experience born of mind-contact, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the decision that has feeling as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the birth that has existence as condition? The birth of the various states, their being born, arising, coming forth, appearance — this is called "the birth that has existence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what are the aging and death that have birth as condition? There is aging, there is death. Therein, what is aging? The aging of the various states, their growing old, the decline of their life span — this is called aging. Therein, what is death? The destruction of the various states, their vanishing, breakup, disintegration, impermanence, disappearance — this is called "death". So this is aging and this is death. This is called "the aging and death that have birth as condition". ⤵ "Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering": thus there is the coming together of this entire mass of suffering, its meeting, its combination, its appearance. Therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".
The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Unwholesome.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.
The Analysis of Dependent Origination is finished.

Katame dhammā abyākatā? Yasmiṃ samaye akusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākaṃ sotaviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ saddārammaṇaṃ…pe… ghānaviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ gandhārammaṇaṃ…pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ rasārammaṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti dukkhasahagataṃ phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ…pe… manodhātu uppannā hoti upekkhāsahagatā rūpārammaṇā vā…pe… phoṭṭhabbārammaṇā vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye akusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Katame dhammā abyākatā? Yasmiṃ samaye akusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākā manoviññāṇadhātu uppannā hoti upekkhāsahagatā rūpārammaṇā vā…pe… dhammārammaṇā vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye akusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso , phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti , jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

Tattha katamo akusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "akusalamūlapaccayā saṅkhāro". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati "viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati "nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ". ⤵ Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati "chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso". ⤵ Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā adukkhamasukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati "phassapaccayā vedanā". ⤵ Tattha katamo vedanāpaccayā adhimokkho? Yo cittassa adhimokkho adhimuccanā tadadhimuttatā – ayaṃ vuccati "vedanāpaccayā adhimokkho". ⤵ Tattha katamo adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo? Ṭhapetvā adhimokkhaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho – ayaṃ vuccati "adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo". ⤵ Tattha katamā bhavapaccayā jāti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jāti sañjāti nibbatti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo – ayaṃ vuccati "bhavapaccayā jāti". ⤵ Tattha katamaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ? Atthi jarā, atthi maraṇaṃ. Tattha katamā jarā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jarā jīraṇatā āyuno saṃhāni – ayaṃ vuccati jarā. Tattha katamaṃ maraṇaṃ? Yo tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati "maraṇaṃ". Iti ayañca jarā, idañca maraṇaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati "jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ". ⤵ Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa saṅgati hoti, samāgamo hoti, samodhānaṃ hoti, pātubhāvo hoti. Tena vuccati evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī"ti.
Akusalamūlakavipākaniddeso.
Abhidhammabhājanīyaṃ.
Paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅgo [paccayākāravibhaṅgo (sī. syā.)] niṭṭhito.
